name: Pudding Pudding Shake
original_name: プリンプリンしぇーく
source:
Once upon a time, in a certain kingdom, there were two very beautiful princesses.
Rent is a servant to these two. He tries to do his best to pay his debt, but the job is very hard.
Because these princesses are.. naughty more than a bit. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE046667.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
从前，在某个王国里，有两位非常美丽的公主。
租金是这两个人的仆人。他尽力偿还债务，但工作非常辛苦。
因为这些公主……有点顽皮。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE046667.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
